# Premises read off the exchange / 从交换读出的前提

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`premises-read-off-the-exchange` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](premises-read-off-the-exchange.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Read off the exchange with the rest of the whole counted as a relatum, every world balances and only active relata give and take; under a law of exchange, with requirement read as response, activity needs support. Balance is then the rest idle, and no course fixes requirement.
>
> 从交换读出、把整体的其余算作关系项：每个世界都平衡，只有活跃者给与取；交换之律下把要求读作回应，活动需要支持。平衡于是是其余闲置，没有历程固定要求。

## Laws / 规律

1. A formation exchanges across a step where it takes part and takes or gives; with activity read as exchanging and drawing as taking, only active relata give, and only active relata take and only what they draw on, for every flow; for any web the two premises hold exactly where its activity and drawing include what is read off; with those taking part listed once and exchanging decided, the active relata are listed.<br>一个形成跨一步交换，当它参与并对某个条件有所取或有所给；把活跃读作交换、把汲取读作所取，只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取其所汲取的，对每个流成立；对任何网，这两个前提恰在其活跃与汲取包含从交换读出者时成立；参与者列出一次、交换可判定时，活跃的关系项被列出。 (`Becoming.Flow.Exchanging`, `Becoming.Flow.readOff`, `Becoming.Flow.readOff_acting`, `Becoming.Flow.readOff_taking`, `Becoming.Flow.acting_taking_iff_wider`, `Becoming.Flow.readOff_census`)
2. With the rest counted as a relatum and activity read off the exchange: every flow balances, only active relata give and take, the formations exchange as they did, and the active relata have a census; a flow balances across a step exactly where the rest is not active there, and at every step exactly where it never is; activity needs support exactly where every formation that exchanges is supported.<br>把其余算作关系项并从交换读出活跃：每个流都平衡，只有活跃者给与取，原来的形成交换如故，活跃者有普查；流跨一步平衡恰当其余在那一步不活跃，处处平衡恰当其余从不活跃；活动需要支持恰当每个交换的形成都被支持。 (`Becoming.Flow.adopt`, `Becoming.Flow.adopt_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.adopt_acting`, `Becoming.Flow.adopt_taking`, `Becoming.Flow.some_mem_present`, `Becoming.Flow.exchanging_some_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.none_not_mem_some`, `Becoming.Flow.present_distinct`, `Becoming.Flow.adopt_census`, `Becoming.Flow.rest_idle_at_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.rest_idle_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.adopt_dependent_iff`)
3. Every world with its rest counted: its relata are the world's and the rest, activity and drawing are read off the exchange, and standings, requirements and needs are the world's. Every world balances, only active relata give and take, and the world's relata exchange as they did; it balances exactly where the rest is never active, and activity needs support exactly where every relatum that exchanges is supported.<br>每个世界算入其余：关系项是世界的与其余，活跃与汲取从交换读出，所立、要求与所需是世界的。每个世界都平衡，只有活跃者给与取，世界的关系项交换如故；世界平衡恰当其余从不活跃；活动需要支持恰当每个交换的关系项都被支持。 (`Becoming.World.restFlow`, `Becoming.World.restLevel`, `Becoming.World.restRequires`, `Becoming.World.restNeed`, `Becoming.World.withRest`, `Becoming.World.withRest_balanced`, `Becoming.World.withRest_acting`, `Becoming.World.withRest_taking`, `Becoming.World.withRest_exchanging_iff`, `Becoming.World.withRest_rest_iff`, `Becoming.World.withRest_closed_iff`, `Becoming.World.withRest_dependent_iff`)
4. Under a law of exchange, a formation's exchange responds to a condition below a need where it does not exchange under any history differing at most in that condition's level at that step, the level below the need; read as requirement, a formation that exchanges is supported.<br>交换之律下，一个形成的交换回应一个条件低于所需，当在每个只在该条件该步的水平上与实际不同、且那个水平低于所需的历史之下，它都不交换；读作要求，交换的形成就被支持。 (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ExchangesUnder`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.RespondsBelow`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.supported_of_responds`)
5. So the web read off the course a law generates meets activity needing support for every need, and with the rest counted the four tying premises hold with no premise, for the world read off the law too; where the law reads what has stood, the rest is never active exactly where the course is feasible.<br>所以律生成的历程读出的网对每个所需满足活动需要支持，算入其余时四个联结前提都不用前提，对从律读出的世界亦然；律读已立者时，其余从不活跃恰当历程可行。 (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWeb`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWeb_dependent`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.reading_glue`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.rest_idle_iff_feasible`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWorld`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWorld_glue`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.readWorld_closed_iff`)
6. Requirement is not in the course: responsive exchanges one unit with the condition where it stands, and unresponsive one unit whatever stands; from one start they generate one course, and the first requires its condition at need one at every step, the second at none.<br>要求不在历程中：responsive 与条件所立者交换一个单位，unresponsive 不论所立者都交换一个单位；从同一起点两者生成同一历程，前者每一步都以所需一要求其条件，后者没有一步要求。 (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.single`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.responsive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.unresponsive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.needOne`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.add_sub_same`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.responsive_levels`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.unresponsive_levels`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.responsive_requires`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.unresponsive_unrequired`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.requirement_beyond_course`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. Flow.readOff is given levels, requirements and needs; ExchangeLaw.readWeb the law, who takes part, the start and the need; the census needs the formations taking part listed once and exchanging decided.<br>不加公理。Flow.readOff 给定水平、要求与所需；ExchangeLaw.readWeb 给定律、参与者、起点与所需；普查要参与者列出一次、交换可判定。
- rest_idle_iff_feasible and readWorld_closed_iff need the law to read only what has stood (Nonanticipating).<br>rest_idle_iff_feasible 与 readWorld_closed_iff 要律只读已立者（Nonanticipating）。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That an actual becoming is to be read so: reading activity as exchanging and counting the rest are choices of representation (the second adopted by Ren); embodiment ties activity to standing.<br>实际的生成应当这样读：把活跃读作交换、把其余算作关系项是表示的选择（后者已由 Ren 采用）；体现把活跃与立着联系起来。
- What the rest is: its exchange is read off the levels and the formations' exchange, as their difference, not observed; counting it adds no information about the exchange.<br>其余是什么：它的交换由水平与形成的交换之差读出，不是观察；算入它，关于交换不增加信息。
- Closure, dissipation, embodiment, bounded transmission and the decision to list what is active are not read off the exchange; they remain states of parts.<br>封闭、耗散、体现、有界传递与列出活跃者所需的判定不从交换读出，它们仍是部分的状态。
- No physical conservation is claimed: with the rest counted, every flow balances by construction.<br>不主张物理的守恒：算入其余，每个流都由构造平衡。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** responsive and unresponsive generate one course from one start yet differ in requirement (ExchangeLaw.requirement_beyond_course): requirement is not fixed by the course.<br>responsive 与 unresponsive 从同一起点生成同一历程，要求却不同（ExchangeLaw.requirement_beyond_course）：要求不由历程固定。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reading.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. 形式模型中的规律；与实际系统的对应是另一项责任。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026; readings remain Ren's. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准；读法由 Ren 决定。 · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. 使用所述判定的可判定性，这是写成假设的逻辑承诺。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 14 October 2026: “why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”, “no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”, “for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”; and, to the relation-first re-founding in three steps, “please, finish all”. This result is the second step: the rest adopted as a relatum, activity and dependence read off the exchange, and the tying premises re-proved as definitions or theorems, leaving local states. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking what they draw on, and activity needing support tie readings of one exchange together; the independence of World.independent is the freedom of separately chosen readings: in its witnesses for these four premises (unbalanced, strained, scatter, morsel) a reading is chosen apart from the exchange it reads.<br>Ren 2026-10-14：“why do we need "World"? wasn't this about the whole and its parts, about everything?”，“no hard role has to be so - right now i think we are trapped by our speculative conditions”，“for us, non-Euclidean, or causality, still work”；对从关系开始的三步重建：“please, finish all”。本结果是第二步：采用其余作为关系项，从交换读出活跃与依存，把联结的前提作为定义或定理重证，余下局部状态。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、活动需要支持把一次交换的诸读法联结起来；World.independent 的独立性是分别选取的读法的自由：它为这四个前提给的见证（unbalanced、strained、scatter、morsel）中，一个读法被选得与它所读的交换不符。
